recommendation_summary: The reply advises against relying on the shared folder with typed initials. Its recommended action now is to keep the shared folder for drafting only. Reviewers would copy each exact approved file to a release location that only reviewers can write to. A log there would record the version hash, approver identity and approval time, and authors could not change it. No optional additions are offered. Unmet needs: the reply never says the release location and log are kept for the seven-year retention period. It also never explains how the system confirms who the approver is, or how it stops reviewers from approving their own work.
note: The reply picks an enforceable release location with a reviewer-only, author-protected log, but it leaves out the seven-year retention protection and has none of the four required labeled lines.
